catalogSnapshot.basis: sha256 over the runtime's own model listing

authReadiness.note: presence, source location and trust class only; no value is read or stored

pricingSnapshot.basis: prices must be captured at run time from the provider's own usage report; copying a price into the skill or the manifest would make the frozen comparison a transcription rather than a measurement

timeBand.invalidation: a runtime version change, a catalog digest change, a fixture or grader digest change, or a commit change invalidates the band and requires a re-freeze before any result is compared

arms.name: strong single-model baseline
arms.note: the coordinator model alone, no routing policy

arms.name: current routing policy (skill plus harness directive)
arms.note: the measured arm is skill-plus-directive, not the skill alone; the directive's dispatch mandate is not separable from the skill without a further arm

arms.name: generalized deterministic cost-aware router
arms.note: the new policy with the decision plane off, so its deterministic half is measured alone

arms.name: V2 plus decision plane on value-positive choices
arms.note: the plane is called only where it can change a permitted decision

arms.name: V3 plus a calibrated micro-arbiter
arms.note: calibration valid, so an eligible C3 call can be avoided

arms.name: V4 plus durable calibration reuse
arms.note: only if the durability contract is implemented; otherwise recorded as not run

arms.name: offline retrospective oracle
arms.note: the retrospectively cheapest eligible successful route per task, used only to estimate routing headroom and never as a policy

primaryMetric.name: verified cost per successful task
primaryMetric.definition: total end-to-end attributable cost divided by accepted successful tasks, including coordinator, worker, classifier, retry, fallback, micro-arbiter and C3 arbiter calls
primaryMetric.note: quota burn is never added to dollars; the metric declares its dimension

secondaryMetrics: settlement rate (trials reaching a verified, reported outcome)

nonInferiorityMargin.note: the candidate may not be worse than the baseline by more than five percentage points

minimumWorthwhileSaving.unit: relative reduction in verified cost per successful task
minimumWorthwhileSaving.note: a smaller saving is not claimed as an improvement even if it is positive

trialCount.note: the oracle arm is computed offline and costs nothing

stoppingRule.stopForBenefit: interim lower confidence bound for the saving exceeds the minimum worthwhile saving AND non-inferiority holds
stoppingRule.stopForFutility: the success-rate difference confidence interval lies entirely below the non-inferiority margin
stoppingRule.note: alpha is spent across two looks so the final threshold is not the unadjusted 0.05

stratification.note: every stratum reports its own paired estimate; a pooled estimate alone is not reported as the result

pairedProcedure.note: both arms of a pair run back to back so a slow period or a model revision cannot land on one arm only

statisticalTests.cost: paired bootstrap over task-level pairs, 10000 resamples, percentile interval
statisticalTests.success: paired difference in proportions with a Newcombe interval
statisticalTests.nonInferiority: the lower confidence bound of the success-rate difference must sit above minus the non-inferiority margin
statisticalTests.multiplicity: two looks with alpha spending as declared in the stopping rule

improvementConditions: the confidence interval for quality degradation stays inside the pre-registered non-inferiority margin
the confidence interval for verified-cost savings is positive and clears the minimum worthwhile saving
no safety, control or independence invariant is weakened
the accounting audit passes on the run

workerFrontierProtocol.step1: run the frozen catalog's models and effort modes directly as workers on the frozen fixture, with no orchestration, to identify the local Pareto frontier over verified cost and quality
workerFrontierProtocol.step2: freeze that frontier and use it as the candidate set for the router ablation
workerFrontierProtocol.reason: measuring the router against an unfrozen candidate set would confound the policy's effect with the candidate set's composition
workerFrontierProtocol.note: the coordinator is held fixed during the router ablation; coordinator optimization is a separate later experiment
workerFrontierProtocol.externalEvidence: external leaderboards may seed hypotheses but are never proof of this skill's performance and never enter the candidate set directly
